questions: Did the dark discoloration and bruising around both eyes appear without a recent injury or surgery?
Have you had easy bruising or prolonged bleeding from other parts of your body?
Do you have frequent nosebleeds or bleeding gums?
Have you recently started taking aspirin, anticoagulants, corticosteroids, or any herbal supplements?
Have you had recurrent sinus congestion, sneezing, or nasal itching?
Have you noticed double vision, reduced vision, eye pain, or numbness of the face?
Have you had fever, night sweats, unexplained weight loss, or swollen lymph nodes?
Have you ever been diagnosed with a bleeding disorder or a blood disorder?
Did the bruising begin within 1–3 days after a blow to the nose, forehead, or other part of the face?
Did you recently undergo rhinoplasty, septoplasty, sinus surgery, facial cosmetic treatment, or another procedure involving the face?
Was there loss of consciousness, vomiting, severe headache, or clear fluid leaking from the nose after the injury?
Did you have nasal pain, swelling, deformity, or difficulty breathing through the nose after the injury?
Is the bruising more prominent on the side of the face that was struck?
Has the discoloration been steadily improving since it appeared?
Did the facial cosmetic treatment involve injections or surgery near the nose, eyelids, forehead, or cheeks?
Did the bruising first appear within 48 hours after that treatment?
Was the treatment an injectable dermal filler, particularly in the nose, tear troughs, cheeks, or forehead?
Did the bruising begin at the treatment site and then spread into both lower eyelids?
Have you had persistent swelling, skin blanching, severe pain, or visual symptoms since the treatment?
Was the treatment performed within the past month?
Did the treatment involve botulinum toxin (Botox or a similar neuromodulator) injections?
Did it involve platelet-rich plasma (PRP), mesotherapy, or multiple small injections around the eyes?
Did it involve laser, radiofrequency, ultrasound, microneedling, or other energy-based skin treatment?
Did it involve thread lifting or another procedure using needles near the cheeks or eyelids?
Did the periorbital discoloration begin more than 48 hours after the procedure?
Have you had any new facial weakness, drooping eyelids, difficulty swallowing, or difficulty breathing since the treatment?
Did the cosmetic treatment involve an actual surgical operation under general or local anesthesia?
Was it an upper or lower blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery)?
Was it a facelift, brow lift, rhinoplasty, or septoplasty?
Were incisions made inside the mouth, in the scalp, or around the ears?
Did the bruising begin immediately or within 24 hours after the operation?
Were you given postoperative instructions that bruising around the eyes was expected?
Did the treatment consist of a chemical peel or application of a strong topical chemical to the face?
Did it involve vigorous facial massage, gua sha, or facial cupping?
Did it involve acupuncture or dry-needling of the face?
Did it involve dental treatment, such as extraction, implants, or local anesthetic injections?
Did the treatment involve nasal endoscopy, nasal packing, or another procedure inside the nose?
Did the bruising begin within 48 hours after the specific treatment?
Was the nasal procedure performed because of a recent head injury or suspected skull-base fracture?
Did the nasal procedure include a biopsy, tissue removal, cauterization, or forceful instrumentation?
Did you develop a nosebleed or nasal bleeding after the procedure?
Was the periorbital discoloration already present before the nasal procedure?
Has the discoloration continued to worsen or spread despite no further procedure?
Do you have a severe or persistent headache since the nasal procedure?
